notes.title: Version 1.1 update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361289/6e3b0edb024ed56ba2cfc0238e4422af805d40c4.png[/img]
We have updated the game today with the following fixes.

- Added a lightweight mode. It can now run on PCs with lower specs. The mode can be switched from the graphics menu in the options.

- Fixed other minor bugs.

We have been updating the application since its release.
Today we think finally able to respond to the many reviews and suggestions we have received since its release. 
New mode,bug fixes, additional option.... and so on.
We are pleased to present this version as Ver. 1.1.
We would like to thank you all for your support that has helped us reach this point.
Thank you !

notes.title: Update: Tutorials mode and more!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361289/6e3b0edb024ed56ba2cfc0238e4422af805d40c4.png[/img]
Thank you for playing "Cabin of Shadows".
We have updated the game today with the following fixes.

-Tutorial has been added.
The tutorial can be accessed from the "Tutorial" button on the bottom left of the menu screen.

-"Ghost" is now initially added to the deck.

-Room creators can now change game settings after a match.

-Fixed matching issues.

The development team is working on further updates. Please stay tuned for the next update.

notes.title: Update: New mode has arrived!
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing "Cabin of Shadows".
Based on the feedbacks we have received since the release of the game, we have added a new mode that specializes in 1vs1 battle balance, which has been requested by many players.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361289/b7100f923d6d971d260b83271e31db2939bd1465.png[/img]
New "Duel Mode"
This new mode focuses on 1vs1 competitive balance.  Players earn scores by winning matches, with the winner being the player whose total exceeds a predetermined score.

The score obtained upon victory changes depending on the combination of roles.
Players may also change the number of points they receive for winning each role before the match.

The existing mode has been updated to "Suspicion Mode"
The existing mode, which is similar to the original rules, has been updated so that players gain more experience when they win in the "Human x Human" and "Werewolf x Werewolf" modes.
Trust between players is indicated by "relationship ranks".

Bug Fix
Fixed a bug that the official Discord link was disabled.

Known Bugs
An unexpected error would occur when creating a room if a player received a friend invitation on the final result screen.
(Please restart the game to resolve this issue.)

When a player finishes a game after his/her role has changed due to the ability of the "fool", the win percentage of the fool is not added to the win percentage of the role after the change.

notes.title: Score rank update and future addition of new modes
notes.notes:
The development team is pleased that the game has received a greater response and enjoyment than expected since its release.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361289/6e3b0edb024ed56ba2cfc0238e4422af805d40c4.png[/img]
Update
We have introduced a system in which the results of a match are rated in four score ranks according to the total points earned during the match.
The four score ranks are Heaven, Peaceful, Chaos, and Hell, in order from best to worst, and are individually directed.

This change is intended to enhance the fun of the original game, which is a mixture of cooperation and competitive, and to increase the purpose of cooperation.

We will continue to brush up on the digital version of the game to provide just the right mix of fun in both cooperative and competitive play.

We are planning to add new modes such as "Duel Mode (tentative name)" and "League Mode (tentative name)," which will focus on competitive play in addition to the current modes, so please stay tuned for more updates that will allow for even more ways to enjoy the game.

notes.title: Update contents and future policies
notes.notes:
We have updated based on the opinions and bug reports received from players.
If you do not update your game to the latest version, you will not be able to find your opponents.

Update
- Added indication of specific role ratios.
- Fixed role appearance ratio.
- The amount of souls is now reduced by 2 points if both players are human or both players are werewolves and are defeated.
- Adjustment of experience gained at the end of a match.
- Fixed a problem in which werewolves appeared too frequently in the game.
- Fixed a bug where the UI disappeared after an error message.

After the release of this game, we have received feedback from many people regarding this game, and some have pointed out its breakdown as a competitive game.
We apologize for the anxiety and inconvenience this has caused.
I would like to explain our future update policy.

We do not want this game to be a competitive game where you can only win or lose or cheat your opponent.
We want to keep a balance where players have to cooperate with each other first, but at the same time, they have to be skeptical that the other player might be a werewolf.
In order to achieve this, the probability of werewolves appearing is very important, but due to a glitch in the current version, werewolves are more likely to appear than expected.
We are planning to update the game today to correct this situation.

At the same time, we will also change the amount of souls reduced in the total takeover rule from -1 to -2 when a player fails in a situation where cooperation between humans or werewolves is required.
This is a balance adjustment to make players more aware of cooperation rather than competition. 
We hope you understand our policy.

We will continue to brush up the balance of the game so that it will be a good mix of cooperation and competition.
We will announce on Twitter and Discord when we have decided on the modification policy.
